info.title: Foodies API
info.description: Foodies API is a RESTful API for a recipe-sharing platform. It supports user authentication, recipe management, adding recipes to favorites, following other users, and searching by categories, cuisine areas, and ingredients.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: User registration, authentication, and session management

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User profiles, avatars, followers, and following

tags.name: Reference Data
tags.description: Reference data: recipe categories, cuisine areas, ingredients, and user testimonials.

post.description: Creates a user account and returns an access token. The refresh token is set in an HTTP-only cookie.

409.description: A user with this email address already exists

post.description: Validates the user's credentials and returns an access token. The refresh token is set in an HTTP-only cookie.

Refreshes the access token using the refresh token from the HTTP-only refreshToken cookie. The refresh token must not be sent in the request body. The server validates the token and checks that the session exists and is active. On success, it generates a new access token and refresh token, stores the hash of the new refresh token in the database, and sets the new token in the cookie. The refresh token is rotated after every successful refresh.

200.description: Access token refreshed successfully. A new refresh token has been set in the HTTP-only cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: A new refreshToken cookie containing the rotated refresh token.

401.description: The refresh token is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked, or the session is no longer active.

message.description: Reason the token refresh was rejected

value.message: Session expired. Please sign in again.
Refresh token has already been used or revoked.

post.description: Revokes the current user's refresh token and clears the cookie.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile and counts of their recipes, favorites, followers, and following. Recipe data is not included; use the recipe endpoints to retrieve recipes.
Returns the user's public profile, recipe and follower counts, and whether the authenticated user follows this profile. Recipe data is not included; use the recipe endpoints to retrieve recipes.

patch.description: Uploads a new user avatar to Cloudinary and updates the avatar URL in the profile.

get.description: Filters are combined. Results are ordered by createdAt DESC, then id DESC. Empty filters are ignored; unknown or duplicate query parameters return 400. Requests without Authorization are public and return isFavorite=false. If a token is provided, it must be a valid access token; otherwise, the response is 401. Responses include Cache-Control: private, no-store and Vary: Authorization.

post.description: The owner is determined from the access token. The recipe and its ingredients are saved together. If the database operation fails, the uploaded image is deleted.

201.description: Created recipe, including its ID, owner, and ingredients

get.description: Returns up to four recipes ranked by the number of distinct users who added them to favorites. Ties are ordered by createdAt DESC, then id DESC. Query parameters are not accepted. Requests without Authorization are public and return isFavorite=false. If a token is provided, it must be a valid access token; otherwise, the response is 401. Responses include Cache-Control: private, no-store and Vary: Authorization.
The list and total include only recipes owned by the authenticated user. Only page and limit parameters are accepted. Results are ordered by createdAt DESC, then id DESC.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number; the offset (page - 1) * limit must not exceed 2147483647.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A 24-character hexadecimal ID. Uppercase letters are accepted.

200.description: Recipe with its owner and ingredients

get.description: Requests without Authorization are public and return isFavorite=false. If a token is provided, it must be a valid access token; otherwise, the response is 401. Responses include Cache-Control: private, no-store and Vary: Authorization.

patch.description: Partially updates a recipe owned by the authenticated user. Include only the fields to be changed; omitted fields remain unchanged. All supplied fields must contain valid, non-empty values. The photo is optional. If no new photo is provided, the existing photo remains unchanged.

403.description: You cannot update another user's recipe

example.message: You can only update your own recipes

409.description: Update conflict: the recipe was modified by another request

delete.description: Deletes the recipe and its ingredient and favorite relationships. Ingredient reference records and users are retained. Repeated deletion returns 404. The photo uploaded through this API is also deleted from Cloudinary. If the image service is unavailable, the recipe remains deleted and the photo's public ID is logged for later cleanup.

204.description: Recipe deleted; response body is empty

get.description: Followers of the specified user, ordered by ID ascending. The isFollowing state is determined for the owner of the access token.
Users followed by the owner of the access token, ordered by ID ascending.

put.description: Creates a follow relationship for the owner of the access token. Following your own profile returns 400.

delete.description: Deletes the follow relationship belonging to the owner of the access token. A missing relationship also returns 204.

get.description: Returns all recipe categories, sorted alphabetically by name and then by ID.
Returns all cuisine areas, sorted alphabetically by name and then by ID.
Returns all ingredients with their names and images. Results are sorted alphabetically by name and then by ID.
Returns user testimonials together with information about their authors. Results are sorted by testimonial ID in ascending order.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated user's favorites. Defaults: page=1 and limit=9; maximum limit is 100. Results are ordered by createdAt DESC, then id DESC. isFavorite is always true. Unknown or duplicate query parameters return 400.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number; the offset (page - 1) * limit must not exceed 2147483647.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A 24-character hexadecimal ID. Uppercase letters are accepted.

put.description: No request body is required. The owner is determined from the access token. The first PUT returns 201; subsequent requests return 200, including concurrent requests. If the recipe does not exist, 404 is returned.

204.description: Relationship does not exist; response body is empty

delete.description: Deletes only the current user's favorite relationship. Returns 204 for repeated requests and when the recipe itself has already been deleted.

refreshCookie.name: refreshToken
refreshCookie.description: HTTP-only cookie containing the refresh token. Automatically set by the server during registration or login.
